observations.observation: The query requested entity home, but retrieval returned work/Paris before home/Berlin, producing the wrong answer.
The query requested entity primary, but top-k ranking returned project distractors and Bath instead of primary/Berlin.
The query requested as_of 2026-01-05, yet the future Paris record was selected over the valid Berlin record.
The query as_of 2026-01-05 returned the future-effective Paris record rather than Berlin.
The query as_of 2026-01-09 returned Paris, whose validity starts on 2026-01-10, rather than Berlin.

hypothesis: Applying entity and temporal filters before ranking will remove cross-entity distractors and records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario retrieval correctness without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Task success and relevant-memory precision should improve on entity-grounding, distractor-retrieval, historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary; distracting and stale retrieval should decrease. Storage and write precision should remain unchanged.
